summary: West Fraser Timber filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing a $500 million three-year term loan maturing September 2029, with partial proceeds retiring its existing $300 million term loan due 2028. The $1 billion syndicated credit facility remains outstanding on existing terms through May 2030, and floating-rate interest is payable on US Base Rate or SOFR advances, repayable anytime without penalty. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.32 per share, payable October 19, 2026, to holders of record September 29, 2026. Pro forma liquidity exceeds $1.2 billion; no deal terms apply.
